d.d: To push or thrust (the nose or snout, face or muzzle, or head, or an object) against or into something.
To rub or touch (someone or something) with the nose, face, etc., or an object.
d.x: The horse nuzzled its foal’s head gently to wake him up.

d.d: Chiefly of an animal: to dig (something, especially food) out of the ground using the nose or snout; to root.
An act of nuzzling (all verb senses).
simple past and past participle of nuzzle
present participle and gerund of nuzzle
The act of one who nuzzles.
